Thanks for the ping, Ethan. Good catch calling out the DST risk. A few practical notes we've used for cross-region demos: 

- Always include UTC (ISO) in the calendar description and put the organizer's local time in the invite title (e.g., "Demo — 2026-03-09 10:00 AEDT / 2026-03-08 17:00 PDT (UTC 2026-03-08 00:00)").
